correctness.rationale: For each odd n>=5 and screening mu>0, the cyclic Green recurrence gives g_d exactly. The variance decomposes into strictly positive coefficients times sharp cyclic-window energies plus f_m(S^2-1). The one-defect word saturates each bound. Every other word has at least 3 monochromatic bonds, giving T2 excess >=8 and variance excess >=16a2; a two-site flip realizes equality with every higher window invariant. Hence the sharp formula, strict positivity, and uniqueness; finite exact Fraction enumeration (n=5,7,9,11,13 at three rational r values, 16,368 spin configurations) corroborates but does not prove the infinite result. The stated two-solve comparison follows from the same variance identity and geometric dominated convergence.

originality.rationale: The central quantitative claim is the exact second-best variance gap on every odd screened cycle, not convex-Ising ground-state ordering (substantially known) or the Rademacher variance identity (known). Comparison with Kerimov 2020, Switzer et al. 2021, the published even-cycle probing record and relevant semantic retrieval found no same or stronger gap bound. Important historical priority risks are reported and no claim of exhaustive uniqueness is made.

The published even-cycle record was available as a semantic result, not full source, so its appendices were not inspected.
The hierarchical-probing paper was abstract-accessible only, and historical priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: Odd cycles force a parity defect in every two-color partition. The theorem does more than identify a known near-alternating ground state: it gives the EXACT cost of the nearest incorrect partition, a screening-dependent computable sharp robustness margin, with an explicit attaining perturbation and finite-size distinction at n=5. This addresses a natural two-solve stochastic trace-probing design ambiguity on periodic odd meshes. The quantity is not arbitrary: it is the next best variance among all admissible nonoptimal designs. No claims extend to other probe budgets or correlated probes.
